title: Belgaum Today — the new Home page
question: Choose the Home landing-page composition. All three keep Home-first navigation and accessible scroll effects. Photography in these comps is illustrative; the built site will use verified imagery.

options.label: Window to India
options.thesis: A cinematic photographic opening makes the breadth of the news feel immediate.
options.viewport: Compact Home-first navigation, a full-width photograph, a bold white headline, and a clear Read the briefing button.
options.risk: Photography must stay quiet enough for the headline and action to remain clear.

options.label: From India to home
options.thesis: A spacious introduction moves from the national picture to Belgaum as the visitor scrolls.
options.viewport: A large navy headline on cool white, a cobalt action, then an expansive Belgaum image that leads into the next section.
options.risk: The opening needs a strong photograph so generous spacing feels intentional.

options.label: Make sense of today
options.thesis: A bold cobalt cover unfolds into a photographic, category-led reading journey.
options.viewport: A full cobalt opening with oversized white type, a white Read the briefing action, and a photographic reveal beneath.
options.risk: The typography carries the first impression, so motion must support reading rather than delay it.
